HoverCard.name: defaultOpen
HoverCard.description:
Whether the preview card is initially open.

To render a controlled preview card, use the `open` prop instead.

HoverCard.name: open
HoverCard.description: Whether the preview card is currently open.

HoverCard.name: onOpenChange
HoverCard.description: Event handler called when the preview card is opened or closed.

HoverCard.name: onOpenChangeComplete
HoverCard.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the preview card is opened or closed.

HoverCard.name: actionsRef
HoverCard.description:
A ref to imperative actions.
- `unmount`: Ends the closing phase of the preview card after an externally controlled closing animation finishes.
Call `preventUnmountOnClose()` in `onOpenChange` first, otherwise the preview card completes closing on its own.
Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by `keepMounted` on the portal.
- `close`: Closes the preview card imperatively when called.

HoverCard.name: handle
HoverCard.description:
A handle to associate the preview card with a trigger.
If specified, allows external triggers to control the card's open state.
Can be created with the PreviewCard.createHandle() method.

HoverCard.name: children
HoverCard.description:
The content of the preview card.
This can be a regular React node or a render function that receives the `payload` of the active trigger.

HoverCard.name: triggerId
HoverCard.description:
ID of the trigger that the preview card is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled preview card.
There's no need to specify this prop when the preview card is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

HoverCard.name: defaultTriggerId
HoverCard.description:
ID of the trigger that the preview card is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open preview card.

HoverCardTrigger.name: handle
HoverCardTrigger.description: A handle to associate the trigger with a preview card.

HoverCardTrigger.name: payload
HoverCardTrigger.description: A payload to pass to the preview card when it is opened.

HoverCardTrigger.name: delay
HoverCardTrigger.description: How long to wait before the preview card opens. Specified in milliseconds.

HoverCardTrigger.name: closeDelay
HoverCardTrigger.description: How long to wait before closing the preview card. Specified in milliseconds.

HoverCardTrigger.name: className
HoverCardTrigger.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

HoverCardTrigger.name: render
HoverCardTrigger.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

HoverCardTrigger.name: style
HoverCardTrigger.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

HoverCardContent.name: className
HoverCardContent.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

HoverCardContent.name: render
HoverCardContent.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

HoverCardContent.name: style
HoverCardContent.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

HoverCardContent.name: align
HoverCardContent.description: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.

HoverCardContent.name: side
HoverCardContent.description:
Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against.
May automatically change to avoid collisions.

HoverCardContent.name: sideOffset
HoverCardContent.description:
Distance between the anchor and the popup in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the distance to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
- `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
- `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.

HoverCardContent.name: alignOffset
HoverCardContent.description:
Additional offset along the alignment axis in pixels.
Also accepts a function that returns the offset to read the dimensions of the anchor
and positioner elements, along with its side and alignment.

The function takes a `data` object parameter with the following properties:
- `data.anchor`: the dimensions of the anchor element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.positioner`: the dimensions of the positioner element with properties `width` and `height`.
- `data.side`: which side of the anchor element the positioner is aligned against.
- `data.align`: how the positioner is aligned relative to the specified side.
